graphState.draft: waiting for you to look it over before it starts
graphState.ready: all done, waiting for you to merge it into main

event.splitting: A plan is to be split{why}
event.ready: All done, waiting for you to merge it into main
event.taskRequeued: {step} has no helper on it any more, queued again
event.draftedSteps: Split into {steps} tasks, waiting for you

problem.tooMany: At most {max} tasks, this has {n}: merge the small ones
problem.badId: "{id}" cannot be a task id: use a short English word, such as api
problem.duplicate: The task id "{id}" is used twice
problem.noCheck: The acceptance task "{id}" has no check command: the command is the acceptance
problem.missing: "{id}" waits for "{other}", which does not exist
problem.circle: These tasks wait for each other in a circle: {ids}

parse.noBlock: No plan found: it goes in a json code block

edit.taskSettled: "{title}" is {state} and cannot be changed now
edit.graphSettled: The plan is {state}; no tasks can be added now
edit.cannotRemove: "{title}" is {state} and cannot be removed: you can skip it
edit.remove: Remove the task "{step}" from the plan "{graph}"

notSaved: The plan "{title}" could not be saved: {why}

notice.notSplit: The plan "{title}" could not be split: {why}
notice.drafted: The plan "{title}" is split into {steps} tasks: look it over under Plans before it starts
notice.unknownFiles: cannot tell which files it changed: {why}
notice.noBranch: the plan has no branch yet
notice.stepNotSaved: The task "{title}" is merged into the plan's branch, but its done state could not be saved: {why}
notice.ready: The plan "{title}" is all done: look over the changes under Plans and merge them into main
notice.stepStopped: "{title}" was stopped and the plan is paused; resume to carry on
notice.helperGone: the helper was sent home before the task was done
notice.restartedSplitting: VibeValley restarted while planning: say again what to do
notice.restarted: VibeValley restarted and the plan is paused; resume to carry on
notice.split: {name} split the ticket "{title}" into {n} sub-tickets and started them
notice.splitNotSaved: The plan's branch {branch} was made, but the split tickets could not be saved: {why}

act.noProject: No project was named: a project is a folder in the work folder
act.noSplitter: No helper can be sent to split the plan
act.plannerNotSent: The planner could not be sent: {why}
act.splittingBy: {name} is reading the code and splitting the plan ({id}). It will be under Plans; look it over before it starts.
act.startNotSaved: The plan's branch {branch} was made, but its start could not be saved: {why}
act.started: The plan "{title}" has started on branch {branch}
act.pausedNote: Paused: the tasks under way finish, no new ones start
act.paused: The plan "{title}" is paused: the tasks under way finish, no new ones start
act.notMerged: Not merged: {why}. The plan's branch {branch} is kept
act.mergeNotSaved: The plan's branch is merged into main, but its done state could not be saved: {why}
act.notFailed: "{title}" did not fail; there is nothing to retry
act.working: "{title}" is in progress: stop it first
act.skipped: Skipped "{title}"; the tasks after it start as usual
act.notStarted: The plan "{title}" has not started and has no branch
act.branchGone: The plan "{title}"'s branch is gone: check whether it was deleted
act.stepsWrong:
The tasks have problems; fix them and split again:
- {problems}
act.abandonedKept: The plan "{title}" is abandoned, the branch {branch} is kept
act.conflict: Merging into {base} would conflict ({files}): {base} changed meanwhile
